title: Nice but too expensive
body: It looks like a nice app, but it only lets you track 3 habits without buying premium – the price is a bit too high if you ask me
author: __Avocadoman

title: New life with this minimalist app
body: Easy setup and easy to follow! I’ve made daily changes by having them here and with a reminder. Tired of old crappy systems, this in comparison is gold. Great sounds, neat design and interface, good tracking over time, black look is hot and progress is motivating. Yeah, this one has made it for some time now. Highly recommended!
author: Sander Eriksen

title: Praktisk och motiverande
body: Enkel att starta med, notification gir en ekstra kick och det samma gjør statistikken. Anbefales

title: Best!
body: The best habit app on App Store and the support is great, highly recommended to pay for it’s premium features.
